skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn my photos into a smooth video slideshow with transitions and music —...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Generator From Photo: turn your photos into smooth MP4 video slideshows with transitions and music in under a minute.
- Upload JPG, PNG, WEBP, or HEIC files (up to 200MB) and get instant AI video creation—no editing skills required.
- Free sessions grant 100 credits with a 7-day token; workflow includes automatic setup and clear status messages.
- Supports easy user commands for uploading files, exporting videos, checking credits, and reviewing project state.
- Exports deliver 1080p MP4 videos ready for social media, processed on cloud GPUs and downloadable within 30–90 seconds.
